review.reason: The mapped course layout, natural single-surface greens, and striped fairways are generally clear and consistent with the reference. Trees visibly intrude into Hole 2’s tee-to-landing corridor, so the current illustration does not meet the wooded-corridor requirement.

issues.detail: Tree crowns sit in the broad corridor from T2 toward the first fairway landing area; clear or relocate the obstructing trees so that corridor reads unobstructed.
issues.consequence: The overview makes Hole 2’s tee shot appear obstructed by trees.
